CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_read_legacy_chat_object(p_bucket text, p_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND (
  (p_bucket='chat-media' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.channel_messages m WHERE public.chat_object_path(m.media_url)=p_bucket||'/'||p_name
      AND split_part(p_name,'/',1)=m.sender_id::text AND public.social_can_read_channel(m.channel_id)))
  OR (p_bucket='chat-media' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.conversations c WHERE c.is_group AND public.chat_object_path(c.group_avatar_url)=p_bucket||'/'||p_name
      AND public.can_access_chat_conversation(c.id)))
  OR (p_bucket='chat-files' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.job_applications a JOIN public.jobs j ON j.id=a.job_id
    WHERE public.chat_object_path(a.cv_url)=p_bucket||'/'||p_name AND split_part(p_name,'/',1)=a.applicant_id::text
      AND (a.applicant_id=auth.uid() OR (j.posted_by=auth.uid() AND public.studio_role() IN ('owner','admin','recruiter')))))
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.chat_media_manifest(p_message_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, media_url text, thumbnail_url text, view_limit smallint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT m.id, CASE WHEN public.chat_object_path(m.media_url) IS NOT NULL THEN m.media_url END, CASE WHEN public.chat_object_path(m.thumbnail_url) IS NOT NULL THEN m.thumbnail_url END, m.view_limit FROM public.messages m
 WHERE cardinality(p_message_ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND m.id = ANY(p_message_ids)
   AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND public.can_access_chat_conversation(m.conversation_id)
   AND (m.media_access_verified OR (
     (public.chat_object_path(m.media_url) IS NULL OR split_part(public.chat_object_path(m.media_url), '/', 2) = m.sender_id::text)
     AND (public.chat_object_path(m.thumbnail_url) IS NULL OR split_part(public.chat_object_path(m.thumbnail_url), '/', 2) = m.sender_id::text)))
   AND (public.chat_object_path(m.media_url) IS NOT NULL OR public.chat_object_path(m.thumbnail_url) IS NOT NULL);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.consume_media_view(p_message_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(url text, remaining integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF to_regnamespace('private_media') IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Update Platinum Circles to open limited-view attachments'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- Installed clients retain their original TABLE(url, remaining) response.
  -- Each legacy call is one consumption, using the same serialized counters as
  -- modern idempotent requests; this does not bypass or reset a view limit.
  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT c.url, c.remaining
      FROM public.claim_chat_media_view(p_message_id, gen_random_uuid()) c;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION content_media_legacy.allows_read(requested_kind text, requested_id uuid, expected_author uuid, current_url text, current_bucket text, current_path text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'is_anonymous')::boolean, false)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM content_media_legacy.snapshots l
      JOIN storage.objects o ON o.id = l.object_id
        AND o.bucket_id = l.bucket_id AND o.name = l.object_path
        AND o.version = l.object_version
        AND (coalesce(o.owner_id, o.owner::text) IS NULL
          OR coalesce(o.owner_id, o.owner::text) = l.author_id::text)
      JOIN storage.buckets b ON b.id = o.bucket_id AND b.public
      WHERE l.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND l.author_id = expected_author
        AND l.bucket_id = current_bucket AND l.object_path = current_path
        AND l.canonical_url = current_url
        AND (
          (l.entity_kind = 'post' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = l.entity_id
              AND p.user_id = l.author_id AND p.created_at = l.publication_created_at
          )) OR
          (l.entity_kind = 'story' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.stories s WHERE s.id = l.entity_id
              AND s.user_id = l.author_id AND s.created_at = l.publication_created_at
          ))
        )
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.content_media_strings(
            public.content_media_document(l.entity_kind, l.entity_id)
          ) AS live_url WHERE live_url = l.canonical_url
        )
        AND (
          (requested_kind = l.entity_kind AND requested_id = l.entity_id)
          OR (requested_kind = 'memory_album' AND l.entity_kind = 'story'
            AND public.can_view_memory_book(requested_id)
            AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.memory_pages mp
              JOIN public.memory_albums a ON a.id = mp.album_id
              WHERE mp.album_id = requested_id AND mp.story_id = l.entity_id
                AND mp.user_id = l.author_id AND a.user_id = l.author_id
            ))
          OR (requested_kind = 'highlight' AND l.entity_kind = 'story'
            AND public.content_story_audience_visible(l.entity_id)
            AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.story_highlight_items hi
              JOIN public.story_highlights h ON h.id = hi.highlight_id
              WHERE hi.highlight_id = requested_id AND hi.story_id = l.entity_id
                AND h.user_id = l.author_id
            ))
        )
    );
$function$
